paper.title: FlowECG: Using Flow Matching to Create a More Efficient ECG Signal Generator

not_substituted: PKUDigitalHealth/PPGFlowECG is a different paper (PPG-guided latent rectified flow). TransDiff/SSSD forks were not used.
pretrained_weights: None published. Paper trains on PTB-XL; any unofficial weights would risk val/test leakage.
published_architecture: Same SSSD backbone as the paper: 36 residual layers, 256 channels, bidirectional S4, 71-label conditioning. Our 4 GB probe of that backbone peaked ~8.2 GB.
reason: No public official implementation. GitHub repository search for FlowECG returned 0 repos. arXiv:2509.10491 and Hugging Face Papers list no code. Do not reimplement flow matching by editing the SSSD sampler. PPGFlowECG is a different method and was not substituted. Published 36x256 SSSD-sized backbone would also not fit 4 GB VRAM (~8.2 GB in the SSSD probe).
